description: Minecraft Fabric mod - Enchantment Overhaul for 1.21.11

mods.name: Enchantment Overhaul
mods.description: Separates enchanting into three distinct systems: Smithing Table for stats, innate material properties, and a reworked Enchanting Table for magic only.

releases.notes:
## Changes
- New shield enchantment, Parry. Blocking within fifteen ticks of raising an enchanted shield throws the attacker back and costs the shield no durability. Holding the shield up past that window behaves like an ordinary shield, so it rewards timing rather than acting as a permanent bonus.
- Shields now have three enchantment slots and can be brought to the catalogue, which also lets them take Mending.
- Parry books generate in pillager outposts, around five percent, and in trial chamber reward chests, around eleven percent.

mods.name: Enchantment Overhaul
mods.description: Separates enchanting into three distinct systems: Smithing Table for stats, innate material properties, and a reworked Enchanting Table for magic only.

releases.notes:
## Changes
- Pillager outposts, abandoned mineshafts, ancient cities, desert pyramids and jungle temples generate the mod's curated enchanted books and smithing templates again. Those five chests are supplied by a built-in datapack, and the loot hook was skipping every table that did not come from the base game. Ancient cities were the main source of Veil and Wraith, so both were close to unobtainable, and Burnishing lost its mineshaft source.

mods.name: Enchantment Overhaul
mods.description: Separates enchanting into three distinct systems: Smithing Table for stats, innate material properties, and a reworked Enchanting Table for magic only.

releases.notes:
## Changes
- Walking Fortress is granted again when wearing a full Warding V set. The equip hook never ran, so the advancement was unreachable in normal play.
- Easy Magic no longer crashes the game on startup. Both mods synced chiseled bookshelf contents by adding the same methods to the same block entity; the sync now hooks the base class instead and the two coexist.
- Honing boosts bow and crossbow projectile damage, replacing the removed Power enchantment, adding +1 base arrow damage at level 1 up to +3 at level 5.
- New game rule honing_on_axes, default on, lets servers stop Honing from applying to axes.
- New game rule enchanting_xp_cost, default on, lets modpacks without an XP economy remove XP level costs from the enchanting table. The catalogue then skips the XP check, does not consume levels, and hides the XP line.
- Catalogue cost labels and game rule names are now translatable instead of hardcoded English, in both shipped languages.
- Rose gold armour from Additional Additions gains innate explosion resistance, matching how vanilla sets work.
- Enchantment slots and smithing template eligibility are data-driven. Datapacks can set an item's slot budget with the slots/tier_3 to tier_6 item tags, and make items upgradeable with the upgradeable/honable, wardable, temperable and grindable tags. Shipped tags reproduce previous behaviour exactly, verified across all 1510 registered items.

releases.notes:
## Changes
- Honing now boosts bow and crossbow projectile damage, replacing the removed Power enchantment. Previously honing a bow did nothing; it now adds +1 base arrow damage at level 1 up to +3 at level 5, matching vanilla Power. Verified for both bows and crossbows with automated game tests.

mods.name: Enchantment Overhaul
mods.description: Separates enchanting into three distinct systems: Smithing Table for stats, innate material properties, and a reworked Enchanting Table for magic only.

releases.notes:
## Changes
- Warding, innate material resistances and Last Stand now apply to players, not only mobs. The damage-reduction hook targeted a method that the player class overrides without calling super, so warded armour, material resistances and Last Stand had no effect on players. Retargeted to the shared damage step both players and mobs run. Verified with automated game tests across all Warding levels, partial sets, every innate material, Last Stand, and a player/mob parity check.

mods.name: Enchantment Overhaul
mods.description: Separates enchanting into three distinct systems: Smithing Table for stats, innate material properties, and a reworked Enchanting Table for magic only.

releases.notes:
## Changes
- Burnishing (axe): right-click weathering copper to strip all oxidation in one click; the axe loses durability equal to the stages skipped.
- Wraith (armor): the enchanted piece is hidden while the wearer has Invisibility, per equipped piece.
- Enchantments already on an item can now be upgraded one level at a time from the catalogue, paying only the delta in reagent, XP and slots.
- Burnishing and Wraith generate as enchanted books in matching structure loot.
